title: feat: show KPI data as it loads
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Shows the dashboard immediately and fills metrics and charts after each source finishes, preserving sequential Tinybird requests.
- Replaces the blocking loading screen with compact progress; pending values remain blank and CSV export waits for completion.
- Resets data on range changes and ignores stale responses; failures do not hide successful data.
- Adds regression coverage: 44 tests pass, Biome passes, and KPI client/Worker bundles build. Full prebuild encounters type errors in unchanged shared UI code.

gist.headline: The numbers trickle in
gist.blurb: The KPI dashboard no longer waits for every number before opening the door. Charts and metrics appear as their sources finish; CSV export patiently waits for the whole set.
gist.summary: The KPI dashboard now renders immediately and fills metrics and charts after each sequential Tinybird request, with compact progress, blank pending values, and CSV export enabled only when loading completes.
gist.impact: Dashboard viewers can inspect finished results sooner; changing the date range clears old data, stale responses are ignored, and a failed source no longer hides successful results.
gist.visual_concept: An internal KPI dashboard on a cozy retro monitor, with chart bars and number tiles lighting up one by one like garden sprouts. Polli, wearing tiny analyst glasses, watches the results arrive while a small CSV folder stays closed until the final tile fills.
